careHPV: Nucleic acid hybridisation with signal amplification and chemiluminescent detection (Hybrid Capture 2 technology); target HPV DNA hybridises to RNA probes\cite{whopr_carehpv}
Xpert HPV: Qualitative real-time PCR targeting the E6/E7 region of the viral DNA genome\cite{cepheid_ifu}

careHPV: 14 types (16, 18, 31, 33, 35, 39, 45, 51, 52, 56, 58, 59, 66, 68); single pooled result, no genotyping\cite{whopr_carehpv,kelly2017}
Xpert HPV: 14 types: HPV 16 and HPV 18/45 reported in two separate channels; 11 other types (31, 33, 35, 39, 51, 52, 56, 58, 59, 66, 68) reported as a pooled result\cite{cepheid_ifu}

careHPV: Cervical specimen in careHPV Collection Medium (careBrush);\cite{whopr_carehpv} self-collected vaginal swabs have been evaluated in studies\cite{kelly2017}
Xpert HPV: Cervical cells in PreservCyt Solution; not validated for vaginal swab specimens collected by a clinician or by the patient\cite{cepheid_ifu,whopr_xpert}

careHPV: Approx. 2.5 h\cite{kelly2017} (approx. 3 h 30 min, 52 steps, in the WHO prequalification report\cite{whopr_carehpv})
Battery-operated; no mains electricity or running water; bench space of about 25 $\times$ 50 cm\cite{kelly2017}
Xpert HPV: GeneXpert system (GeneXpert Dx, Infinity-48s or Infinity-80), GeneXpert Dx software 4.3 or higher or Xpertise 6.1 or higher, and barcode scanner\cite{cepheid_ifu,whopr_xpert}
Not stated in the instructions for use or in the WHO prequalification report\cite{cepheid_ifu,whopr_xpert}
Cartridges and reagents 2--28 \textdegree{}C, shelf life 18 months\cite{cepheid_ifu,whopr_xpert}

careHPV: 1 pg/mL (cut-off used in all studies reviewed by Kelly et al.)\cite{kelly2017}
Xpert HPV: Result interpreted automatically by the instrument software; pooled result reported as ``HR HPV POS''\cite{cepheid_ifu}

careHPV: WHO prequalified (listed 13 July 2018; PQDx 0085-028-00); intended for primary screening in women aged 30 years and older\cite{whopr_carehpv}
Xpert HPV: CE-IVD marked;\cite{cepheid_ifu} WHO prequalified (listed 21 December 2017; PQDx 0268-070-00)\cite{whopr_xpert}
